title: Approve the questionnaire before customer use
requirement: Every bank row has a named owner/counsel/underwriting decision; the seven replaced windows are restored or explicitly approved; sourceVerified is true only with evidence; QUESTIONNAIRE_VERSION is bumped and the report regenerated.
acceptance: A signed 37-row decision table exists; check:bank passes; no held row is offered; every count in customer/reviewer copy is generated from the bank.

title: Make the server authoritative for the snapshot and crisis state
requirement: The public endpoint rebuilds every answer from a canonical bank and rejects held, unknown, altered, incomplete and stale rows; crisis_disclosure and review flags are derived from the answer set, never trusted from the client.
acceptance: Forged MED-11/INVENTED-99/zero-answer/not-applicable payloads return 422; MH-05 Yes with a false crisis flag fails closed or stores true.

title: Make consent evidence server-owned
requirement: Consent IDs, versions, wording hashes, seller/channel policy and receipt time are server-owned; forged marketing/privacy evidence is rejected; the privacy version matches; revocation and suppression are enforced before any channel is enabled.
acceptance: Wrong version/text, duplicate/unknown IDs, disabled-channel marketing and future timestamps return 422; STOP/withdrawal creates a suppression and blocks outbound.

title: Preserve answer integrity and the adult/self boundary
requirement: Branch-closed details are purged from state, payload, summary and portal; adult/self and US-state rules are server-enforced; not_applicable is approved or removed.
acceptance: Parent flip leaves no hidden fields; 17-year-old, ZZ and third-party payloads are rejected; every branch test passes.

title: Protect review and submission integrity
requirement: A forged or stale acknowledgement is rejected server-side; edits invalidate the prior confirmation; one draft creates at most one case.
acceptance: Arbitrary ack/version is rejected; edit then old ack is rejected; double submit/timeout creates one case.

title: Make delivery reliable and evidence trustworthy
requirement: Idempotency, claimed/leased retries, provider idempotency, signature-verified/deduplicated/monotonic webhooks, committed JWT/schedule config and honest not_sent copy.
acceptance: Concurrent/timeout submissions create one case; crash/overlap sends one email; replayed/out-of-order events cannot change status; confirmation matches state.

title: Verify secure reviewer access
requirement: Live RLS is verified with anonymous, authenticated non-reviewer and reviewer; AAL2 is required; opened access is logged; a forwarded reference alone is denied.
acceptance: Password-only session sees zero cases and cannot call RPCs; after step-up it succeeds; opened entry exists; forwarded reference denied.

title: Implement data lifecycle and incident controls
requirement: Retention/deletion, backup expiry, incident response, revocation/suppression, mailbox ownership and provider settings are documented, implemented and tested.
acceptance: Labelled deletion is audited; backups expire; incident runbook names owner/contact; STOP blocks outbound; provider settings reviewed.

title: Close customer and provider exposure
requirement: Held source text is not shown to customers; privacy version is correct; customer/reviewer counts are accurate; bundle/logs/URLs/email/provider settings are re-checked for health data.
acceptance: Held wording absent from customer DOM/bundle; privacy record matches displayed version; generated count check passes; no health data in logs/email/URLs.

title: Obtain legal and clinical approvals
requirement: Counsel approves the entity, privacy notice, intake permission, TCPA disclosure (if any), sensitive-question handling and HIPAA/Texas position; clinical review approves the crisis script.
acceptance: Signed approvals identify the entity, versions, dates and scope; no 'HIPAA compliant' or 'TCPA compliant' claim is made from this audit.

title: Complete operational readiness
requirement: Mailbox ownership, sender domain, provider settings, monitoring, on-call, deployment config and a labelled non-customer end-to-end test are confirmed.
acceptance: Non-customer case reaches the approved mailbox; reviewer signs in with MFA; one failed delivery is observed and recovered; on-call/contact is documented.

title: Pin and reproduce the supply chain
requirement: Dependencies are updated, CI actions are SHA-pinned, install scripts reviewed, Deno dependencies pinned and deno.lock committed.
acceptance: No high advisory remains; CI uses the lockfile; a clean build resolves the same versions.

title: Keep real data out until the blockers close
requirement: The environment remains in labelled preview mode; no real applicant data is accepted until all launch-blocking findings and MC-01..MC-12 are closed.
acceptance: Written confirmation that the environment accepts fictitious data only; live mode remains off.
